info.name: Transport ERP - Phase 1 Fleet Core
info.description:
Complete API collection for Transport ERP Phase 1.

**Setup:**
1. Run the 'Login' request first to get your JWT token
2. The token is auto-saved to the `authToken` collection variable
3. All other requests use this token automatically

**Default Admin Credentials:**
- Username: admin
- Password: admin123

request.description: Login with credentials. The JWT token is auto-saved to the `authToken` variable.
Register a new user. Available roles: SUPER_ADMIN, OWNER, FLEET_MANAGER, DISPATCHER, ACCOUNTANT, HR, MAINTENANCE_MANAGER, DRIVER, VIEWER
Refresh an expired access token using a valid refresh token.
List all registered users. Requires USER_VIEW permission.
Partial update — only non-null fields are changed. You can update any combination of: fullName, email, phone, password, roles, branchId, active.
Change only the password for a user. All other fields remain unchanged.
